Case: Mattie is a 75-year-old with history of lung cancer and 4 months of progressive low-back and right leg pain. Mattie describes the pain as a dull ache that shoots down his right leg in no particular pattern or frequency. Recently, he started experiencing intermittent numbness throughout his right leg. Question: Would you offer morphine to Mattie? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
